name: Polar sea ice
summary: Arctic and Antarctic sea ice about 1.65M km² below average
state: On 2 Nov Arctic sea-ice extent was about 1.65 million km² below the 1981–2010 average, and Antarctic extent about 1.64 million below, within the Watch band. Neither pole is at a record low for the date.
for_you: No direct action; low sea ice affects long-term climate and weather patterns.
rubric_hit: Worst anomaly −1.65M km² in Watch band
why: Sea ice reflects sunlight and regulates ocean circulation; record lows accelerate warming.
drivers: Air and ocean temperatures, winds, season.

rubric.alert: Either pole at a record low for the calendar date.
rubric.normal: Arctic and Antarctic extent anomalies both above −1.0 million km² vs 1981–2010.
